target.statement: Target-DPO (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B) achieves 89.0 pass@1 on HumanEval Base

compute.basis: Reproducing the headline number requires preference-pair synthesis with GPT-4o (closed API), DPO training of a 7B model (needs GPU), and evaluation; the released repo likely lacks the CodeFlow dataset and full training configs.

blockers: Preference data synthesis depends on GPT-4o (closed-source API)
DPO training of a 7B model requires GPU (not feasible on 8-core CPU laptop)
CodeFlow dataset (59k pairs) may not be fully released
Full training configs and hyperparameters may be missing
title: Teaching Your Models to Understand Code via Focal Preference Alignment
